title: No Proceedings after Compounding
description: Where an offence has been compounded, no proceeding or further proceeding shall be taken against the offender in respect of the offence so compounded

content.general_rule: Any offence punishable under sections 88 and 89 may, either before or after the institution of the prosecution, be compounded on payment of such amount as may be prescribed, subject to the leave of the court where a complaint has been filed under section 92 and to the maximum amount of the fine imposable
content.exception: Where an offence has been compounded, no proceeding or further proceeding, as the case may be, shall be taken against the offender in respect of the offence so compounded
conditions: the offence has been compounded under sub-section (1) of section 96
where a complaint has been filed under section 92, the compounding was made with the leave of the court

aliases: Payment of fine in lieu of prosecution
user_queries: Can an offence under section 88 be compounded after prosecution has started?
What is the condition for compounding an offence under section 89?
Can a complaint be filed under section 92 without leave of the court?
What is the maximum amount that can be imposed as a fine for a compounded offence?
Can an offence be compounded without payment of a prescribed amount?
